terra.problem: Calling Paul an apostle of Jesus adds a Bible fact from outside this passage without a reference.
The cookie joke makes light of the oath to kill Paul by comparing it to going without a cookie.
The text does not establish that everything else in the plotters' day remains available to them.
More than forty means the number was definitely bigger than forty, not merely that it could be.
Ninety is consistent with more than forty. Also, forty-plus can include exactly forty, which the text excludes.
The plotters speak to the chief priests and elders, not to the Sanhedrin as a whole.
The text says the plotters speak to the chief priests and elders. It does not say they address the Sanhedrin.

The claim that this was the quickest message delivery in the whole city is invented. Marking it as a bet does not make an unsupported factual claim a permitted guess at a feeling.
Saying the commander gets the news before the request arrives implies that the request does arrive. The passage does not say that it does.
